chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, who said:
Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The disaster for the Religion is envy, self-conceit, and pride.

key_terms.الْحَسَدُ: Envy (desiring the removal of a blessing from another)
key_terms.الْعُجْبُ: Self-conceit (being pleased with one's own good deeds)
key_terms.الْفَخْرُ: Pride (boasting about one's good deeds to others)

ai.seo_question: What are the three main spiritual diseases that corrupt religion according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this concise hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies envy, self-conceit, and pride as the 'plague' (afah) of religion, highlighting their capacity to corrupt both inner faith and outward practice. This triad is often interpreted by Shia scholars as a progression from internal deficiency (envy) to internal arrogance (conceit) to external display (pride), all of which sever the believer from divine grace. The term 'afah' suggests a contagious and destructive affliction, emphasizing the urgency of purifying the heart from these spiritual diseases to maintain the integrity of one's deen.
